answerVersions.rawOpenAIAnswer:
The "Assistance for persons" provides insurance to cover you if anything happens while you're travelling. This includes coverage for various insured events such as:

- Illness, accident, or death
- Loss of employment
- Breakdown/delay of public transport
- Breakdown of the vehicle or taxi you are travelling in
- Damage to your property at home
- Incidents occurring en route to or after arrival at your destination (e.g., strikes, terrorism, volcanic eruption, or other natural events)
- Grounding, strike, or bankruptcy of your airline or tour operator

Additionally, it offers benefits while travelling, which include:

- Call-back and transport costs
- Refundable cost advance while abroad
- Additional costs for board and lodging
- Unused services due to the premature interruption of your holiday
- Search, rescue, and recovery costs
- Additional expenses

This coverage ensures that you are protected during your travels for unforeseen events. 

Source: [assistance-brochure.pdf, page 4]

- Illness, accident or death
- Loss of employment
- Breakdown/delay of public transport
- Breakdown of the vehicle or taxi you are travelling in
- Damage to your property at home
- Incidents occurring en route to or after arrival at your destination (e.g. strikes, terrorism, volcanic eruption or other natural events)
- Grounding, strike or bankruptcy of your airline or tour operator

This insurance will cover the cost if you have to cancel, abort, or extend your trip.
